#summary Video Tutorial on how to setup a project for EMFStore server.

 <wiki:video url="http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VGItDKa2K4g"/> 

This tutorial explains how to setup a project for EMFStore server. The UNICASE version used in this video is 0.5.2 which uses the EMFStore/ECP in version 0.9.3.

In order to follow this tutorial, you need to check out the UNICASE plug-ins and install EMFStore.

See:<br />
[http://code.google.com/p/unicase/wiki/RunClientTutorial Run UNICASE Client as a Developer]<br />
[http://code.google.com/p/unicase/wiki/RunServerTutorial Run EMFStore Server as a Developer]
